name: inframonitor-agent
description: Agente proxy de monitoramento do InfraMonitor AI (ping + SNMP + relay de NetFlow/Syslog) para redes atrás de NAT/firewall.

scripts.build:win: npm run build && pkg dist/index.js --targets node20-win-x64 --output InfraMonitorAgent.exe
scripts.build:linux: npm run build && pkg dist/index.js --targets node20-linux-x64 --output InfraMonitorAgent
